caseName: Pierce v. Obion Co. ex rel. Mercantile Trust Co.
caseNameFull: Walter W. Pierce v. Obion Company for use, etc., and Mercantile Trust Company
attorneys: Mr. Thos. H. Malone, with whom Mr. Wm. H. Swiggart was on the brief, for plaintiffs in error. Mr. Charles C. Allen, Jr., with whom Mr. S. A. Mitchell was on the brief, for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per. Curiam.

Dismissed for want of a substantial Federal question on the authority of Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; Norton v. Whiteside, 239 U. S. 144, 147.
